title: Reverse a Number
description: Reverse the digits of an integer using a loop.
code:
num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
original = num
reversed_num = 0

while num > 0:
    digit = num % 10
    reversed_num = reversed_num * 10 + digit
    num //= 10

print(f"Reverse of {original} is {reversed_num}")
expectedOutput: Enter a number: Reverse of 1234 is 4321
